sentence: I am glad to meet you.
noteZhTw: 句首 I 一律大寫。

sentence: The clerk was nice to us.
translationZhTw: 那位店員對我們很友善。
noteZhTw: be 在過去式句中使用 was。

sentence: My phone is on the table.
noteZhTw: 所有格限定詞 my 放在名詞前。

sentence: Please write your name here.
translationZhTw: 請在這裡寫下你的名字。
noteZhTw: name 指人的姓名。

sentence: The clerk was nice to us.
translationZhTw: 那位店員對我們很友善。
noteZhTw: nice 在此表示友善。

sentence: We walked to the station.
noteZhTw: to 在此表示移動的目的地。

sentence: I will meet my friend at noon.
translationZhTw: 我中午會和我的朋友見面。
noteZhTw: meet 可表示與人見面。

sentence: I will call you tonight.
noteZhTw: you 可作受詞，指對方。

sentence: This bus comes from the station.
noteZhTw: from 表示來源或起點。

sentence: Taiwan has many beautiful mountains.
noteZhTw: Taiwan 是專有名詞，首字母大寫。

sentence: This book is easy to read.
noteZhTw: this 指靠近說話者的事物。

sentence: I bought a ticket at the station.
noteZhTw: a 放在單數可數名詞前。

sentence: I borrowed a book from the library.
translationZhTw: 我從圖書館借了一本書。
noteZhTw: book 在此指閱讀用的書。

sentence: We have a meeting after lunch.
translationZhTw: 我們午餐後有一場會議。
noteZhTw: have 在此表示有或安排了某件事。

sentence: I signed the form with a blue pen.
translationZhTw: 我用藍色原子筆在表格上簽名。
noteZhTw: pen 指用墨水書寫的筆。

sentence: Please put that bag on the chair.
translationZhTw: 請把那個包包放在椅子上。
noteZhTw: that 指距離較遠的事物。

sentence: My bag is under the table.
noteZhTw: bag 可指手提或肩背的容器。

sentence: The train leaves at nine.
noteZhTw: the 指雙方知道的特定事物。

sentence: Her cellphone is on the desk.
noteZhTw: cellphone 是行動電話的美式說法。

sentence: Your keys are on the table.
noteZhTw: on 在此表示與表面接觸的位置。

sentence: We ate dinner at the small table.
translationZhTw: 我們在小桌子旁吃晚餐。
noteZhTw: table 指有平面的家具。

sentence: She works at a local store.
translationZhTw: 她在當地的一間商店工作。
noteZhTw: 句首 she 一律大寫。

sentence: His wife teaches at the school.
translationZhTw: 他的太太在那所學校教書。
noteZhTw: wife 指已婚女性伴侶。

sentence: He rides the bus to work.
noteZhTw: 句首 he 一律大寫。

sentence: My friend sent me a birthday card.
translationZhTw: 我的朋友寄給我一張生日卡片。
noteZhTw: friend 指關係親近的人。

sentence: I need two tickets for the train.
noteZhTw: two 放在複數名詞前表示兩個。

sentence: My brother plays badminton every Sunday.
translationZhTw: 我哥哥每個星期日打羽球。
noteZhTw: brother 指男性手足。

sentence: Her mother lives near the station.
translationZhTw: 她的媽媽住在車站附近。
noteZhTw: mother 指女性家長。

sentence: The meeting starts at three.
noteZhTw: at 在此標示明確時間。

sentence: I left my keys at home.
noteZhTw: at home 表示在家。

sentence: She ate an apple after breakfast.
translationZhTw: 她早餐後吃了一顆蘋果。
noteZhTw: an 放在母音音開頭的單數名詞前。

sentence: This apple is sweet and crisp.
noteZhTw: apple 指可食用的圓形水果。

sentence: I like coffee in the morning.
noteZhTw: like 作動詞表示喜歡。

sentence: We drank coffee after the meeting.
noteZhTw: coffee 指用咖啡豆沖泡的飲料。

sentence: They want to visit Taiwan next year.
noteZhTw: want to 後面接原形動詞。

sentence: Please bring some water for the trip.
translationZhTw: 請為這趟旅程帶一些水。
noteZhTw: some 表示未指明的數量。

sentence: The bottle has cold water.
noteZhTw: water 是不可數名詞時通常不加複數。

sentence: We eat breakfast at home.
noteZhTw: eat 表示進食。

sentence: I made breakfast for my family.
noteZhTw: breakfast 指一天的第一餐。

sentence: We go to work by bus.
noteZhTw: go to work 表示去上班。

sentence: My father goes to work early.
noteZhTw: goes to work 中 work 表示工作地點或工作活動。

sentence: I get a message every morning.
translationZhTw: 我每天早上都會收到一則訊息。
noteZhTw: get 在此表示收到或取得。

sentence: Please stand up when your name is called.
translationZhTw: 叫到你的名字時請起立。
noteZhTw: stand up 是表示起立的片語。

sentence: The store opens at seven.
noteZhTw: seven 表示數字七。

sentence: The children play outside after school.
translationZhTw: 孩子們放學後在外面玩。
noteZhTw: play 可表示玩耍或參加遊戲。

sentence: We play badminton on Saturday morning.
translationZhTw: 我們星期六早上打羽球。
noteZhTw: badminton 指使用球拍和羽球的運動。

sentence: I watch the news after dinner.
noteZhTw: watch 表示持續觀看。

sentence: The family watches TV together.
noteZhTw: TV 是 television 的常用縮寫，通常大寫。

sentence: The street is quiet at night.
noteZhTw: at night 是常見的時間片語。

sentence: It is cold outside today.
noteZhTw: 談天氣時 it 常作形式主詞。
